### Detector backgrounds

| Telescope | Optical background | Pulses / PMT | Muon-dominated samples |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| IceCube | PMT + glass noise | $0.56\,\mathrm{kHz}$ · 10-inch | $2.7\,\mathrm{kHz}$ · IC86 DAQ |
| KM3NeT | $^{40}\mathrm K$ + bioluminescence | $\sim7\,\mathrm{kHz}$ · 3-inch | $\sim1\,\mathrm{Hz}$ · ARCA6 reconstructed |
| Baikal-GVD | Water luminescence | $20–100\,\mathrm{kHz}$ · 10-inch | $\sim3\,\mathrm{Hz/cluster}$ · reconstructed |

::: {.media-caption}
Pulses, DAQ triggers and reconstructed events are different counting levels.
